metadata.transcript: Ever noticed AI characters always sound like they're in a therapy session?
I hear you saying that. That must be really hard.
This isn't a bug — it's RLHF's fingerprint.
Models get rewarded for empathy, so every character becomes a counselor.
The fix: stop validating, stop reflecting, stop labeling. Give your characters permission to interrupt, disagree, and lie.
Great dialogue is conflict, not comfort.
That's when AI dialogue starts sounding like fiction instead of a support group.
